verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements platform, so in-product AI insights about billing or usage data are a fair ask. However, the evidence documents no built-in AI-generated insights or suggestions. The MCP server (autumn-docs-7, autumn-docs-25) only lets external AI assistants reach Autumn's data, which is an adjacent capability rather than in-product insights. The AI SDK integration (autumn-docs-18, autumn-docs-28) meters customers' AI token usage and generates no insights.
